Built a complete, responsive basketball idle game in `index.html`.

- Shoot hoops for cash, build streaks, and track your career stats.
- Buy court and team upgrades to earn passive income.
- Progress through leagues, with auto-save and up to 8 hours of offline earnings.
- Includes sound controls and a reset option.

Assumption: shots have a chance to score, while your crew earns money automatically as you upgrade. I checked the game in desktop and mobile browser sizes and verified the JavaScript parses without errors.
